evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies wallet scanning infrastructure in src/wallet/scan.{h,cpp} and src/wallet/wallet.{h,cpp}.
rationale: Parallelizing compact filter checks delivers a verified 4.5x to ~8x speedup on wallet fast rescans, addressing the explicit category priority of slow rescans. Reviewer benchmarks confirm dropping rescan times on 200,000 blocks from ~270s down to 35-60s with 8 to 16 threads.
